title: Crispy Saganaki Fritters with Greek Cheese
description: A twist on Greek appetizers, these crispy fritters filled with saganaki cheese will delight your taste buds.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, whisk together flour, egg, and milk to make a batter.
2. Add crumbled greek cheese, saganaki cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper to the batter. Mix well.
3. Heat olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
4. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil.
5. Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
6. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the crispy fritters warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
